comments: Release date identifies the currently available version submitted on 26 October 2026; it is not a claim about the first historical launch date.
features: Free online check of ten common accessibility issues on a website home page, in French. No account required; results are kept 24 hours, then deleted. Checks only what can be detected in the code of one page: not a substitute for a full RGAA or WCAG audit.
title: Claren accessibility check
